label: Gir

names.text: Taken from the infobox, lead and history section of the Wikipedia article. The infobox spells Bhodah as "Bhodali"; the lead and history section use "Bhodah".

about.text: A zebu breed from the Kathiawar peninsula of Gujarat, India, named after the Gir Hills. Its traditional range was Amreli, Bhavnagar, Junagadh and Rajkot districts, and it has since spread to Maharashtra and Rajasthan. Its milk is used for dairy, and it is known for milk production.

sources.text: Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch: origin, range, spread, and the dairy use. The article's milk-production statement cites Porter et al. (2016).

origin.place: Kathiawar peninsula, Gujarat, India; named after the Gir Hills. Traditional range Amreli, Bhavnagar, Junagadh and Rajkot districts, since spread to Maharashtra and Rajasthan.

sources.text: Wikipedia article, read on WebFetch. No formation dates given.

Wikipedia article: dairy is the listed use. Brazilian selective breeding since the 1960s produced separate dairy (Gir Leiteiro) and beef strains. Draught and dual-purpose use are not mentioned.
